item.title: Starkville to hire West Point’s Brett Morgan as next head coach
item.description: Almost one week after the vacancy opened for Starkville’s next head football coach, the Yellow Jackets are set to usher in a new era with a coach from a nearby powerhouse program – West Point’s Brett Morgan. item.title: Mississippi officials scale back Healthy Moms, Healthy Babies program to 10 counties
item.description: The Mississippi State Department of Health is overhauling its home visitation and care management program for high-risk pregnant women and infants in an effort to move the needle on the state’s high infant mortality rate. item.description: President Donald Trump’s approval rating is sinking and gasping for air. His average net approval stands at -13.7, which is lower than Joe Biden’s was at this point in his term. item.title: Speaker Johnson says he disapproves of Justice Department logging lawmaker searches of Epstein files
item.description: Republican House Speaker Mike Johnson said Thursday that he did not think it was appropriate for the Justice Department to be tracking the search histories of lawmakers who are reviewing files from the Jeffrey Epstein investigation. item.title: Other Editors: Tariffs vs the working class
item.description: For decades, politicians have sold tariffs as a tonic for the working class. In reality, one particular group seems to benefit more than any other from trade wars: Washington influence peddlers. The post Other Editors: Tariffs vs the working class appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: House votes to slap back Trump’s tariffs on Canada in rare bipartisan rebuke
item.description: The House voted Wednesday to slap back President Donald Trump’s tariffs on Canada, a rare if largely symbolic rebuke of the White House agenda as Republicans joined Democrats over the objections of GOP leadership.
